name: Special Module on Professional Ethics -1
description: This module will bring out the need for professional ethics as recognized by several professional bodies in the world through discussion of practical case studies and the underlying tenets of the code of conduct of professional bodies. The course will initiate discussion on reasons behind deviation from these tenets and the relevance of these tenets of professional ethics in the contemporary world.
